summary: Iter54 backend ecosystem test: 47/47 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter54_accounts_ecosystem.py. Covered: ECDSA-P256 device registration + verify, creator-signature gate enforcement on 22 creator-only endpoints (/api/accounts/list, rename-pseudo, mute, unmute, exclude, ban, unban, history, history/clear, visit, delete-user-project, remove-creator + /api/ideas/{inbox,mark-read,delete} + /api/announcements/{create,delete} + /api/polls/{create,delete} + /api/exports/{decide,pending} + /api/creator/translate — all correctly reject non-creator signed payloads with 403), non-creator happy paths (/api/ideas/send signed OK, /api/exports/request → pending, /api/exports/status polling, /api/polls/vote 404 on missing poll, /api/announcements/list + /api/polls/list public GETs), signature security (invalid sig → 403, unsigned → 422), /api/auth/update-pseudo (too-short 400 / reserved 409 / happy 200), duplicate-pseudo /api/auth/register now SUCCEEDS (uniqueness check removed as specified), /api/accounts/list security contract (no _id, no public_key_jwk in projection — verified statically in server.py L6521-6523). Frontend static checks PASS for all 6 new iter54 components (AccountsButton, IdeasButton, AnnounceButton, AnnouncementsBanner, ExportApprovalNotifier, AccountVisitView) + LanguageContext i18n key prefixes (acc_, ideas_, ann_, poll_, exp_, pseudo_, kick_excluded, kick_banned) + Dashboard.js wires AccountsButton. Frontend Playwright smoke: Landing renders cleanly (0 JS pageerrors), theft-labelled-btn count=1 with text 'Report theft' ✓, message-creator-icon-btn count=1 ✓ (iter53 regression is FIXED), /login renders correctly. Could NOT runtime-test creator-only UI (Dashboard accounts panel, announce panel, ideas inbox, export approval notifier, account visit view) because the preview environment has no creator IndexedDB key — the original creator device is the first ever registered and its private key is unrecoverable. Main agent must verify creator-side UI manually in a browser session where they hold the creator key, OR provision a fresh DB to mint a new creator device.

minor.issue: Cascade falls back to plain text (returns {translated: text, error: 'translate_unavailable'}) when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is unset or gpt-5.2 upstream returns 502. Per review request this is acceptable, but the endpoint always returns 200 even on failure — frontend should check the optional `error` field, not status code.
Public GET — anyone can enumerate audience='all' announcements/polls without any rate-limit or auth. Low priority but worth knowing.

action_items: Manually verify creator-side UI (AccountsButton panel: rename/mute/exclude/ban/history/visit; AnnounceButton: announce/poll/manage tabs; IdeasButton inbox; ExportApprovalNotifier modal) in a browser where you hold the creator IndexedDB key. The signed-call wiring is proven correct from the backend side (47/47).

Optional: cosmetic check — the `creator/translate` endpoint returns 200 even on LLM failure. Frontend should inspect `error: 'translate_unavailable'` to show a graceful fallback banner instead of pretending the translation worked.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L6521-6523 — projection `{"_id": 0, "public_key_jwk": 0}` on /api/accounts/list correctly strips both private-key material and Mongo ObjectId. ✓
server.py L6587-6605 /api/accounts/exclude — duration_minutes is HARD-CAPPED at 60*24*90 (90 days), no infinite option, AND user_sessions for the target email are wiped on exclusion → matches spec.

server.py L6608-6627 /api/accounts/ban — sets banned=True + writes banned_emails row (email-level lock, survives device re-register) + wipes sessions. /api/devices/verify L4196-4201 reads `banned` and `excluded_until` and emits kick_banned / kick_excluded. End-to-end gate correct.
server.py L6704-6731 /api/accounts/remove-creator — bcrypt.checkpw on stored password_hash, demotes to 'approved' only on success, logs decision. ✓

server.py L7059-7076 /api/auth/update-pseudo — session-auth gated; updates both users.pseudo and users.pseudo_lower (matches partial unique index from ensure_indexes), then propagates to device_keys.pseudo/label.

server.py L7105-7113 ensure_indexes — pseudo_lower index is PARTIAL (only enforces uniqueness when verified=True AND pseudo_lower exists). This is what allows duplicate-pseudo register to succeed in test_15.
server.py L6499-6514 _disambiguate_pseudos — clean #N appending for duplicates with display-only field. Doesn't mutate underlying pseudo. ✓
server.py L6946-6971 /api/exports/request — short-circuits with `{approved: True, auto: True}` when role='creator', otherwise idempotent-upserts a pending request. Good UX.

server.py L7034-7052 /api/creator/translate — wrapped in try/except that returns 200 with `error: translate_unavailable` fallback on Emergent LLM failure. Note: requires `from emergentintegrations.llm.chat import LlmChat, UserMessage` to be installable; smoke test only confirms gate (403 for non-creator).

Front-end smoke: all 6 iter54 components exist and are non-stub (>200 bytes). Dashboard.js mounts AccountsButton. LanguageContext.js carries all required i18n prefixes including kick_excluded / kick_banned.

success_rate.frontend: static 100% (8/8); runtime Landing 100% (TheftButton + MessageButton both visible, 0 JS errors); creator-only UI NOT runtime-tested (no creator key)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 47 iter54 backend tests are GREEN. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter54_accounts_ecosystem.py is self-contained and idempotent: it generates a fresh ECDSA-P256 key per run, registers as a pending device, exercises every non-creator path, and asserts every creator-gated endpoint rejects with 403. To extend with creator-side coverage you need to either (a) seed a known creator key into device_keys with a known private key, or (b) test through the frontend in a browser session that already holds the creator IndexedDB key. Note: /api/creator/translate may return 200 with `error: translate_unavailable` if Emergent LLM gpt-5.2 is unhealthy — that's expected per spec. Front-end runtime: Landing is clean (TheftButton + MessageButton both visible); /login form has readonly inputs until focused (anti-autofill, unrelated to iter54).
rca of the issue: No bugs found in iter54. All 22 creator-only endpoints correctly enforce ECDSA signature + role=creator gating via _require_creator_signature(); all 7 public/signed-non-creator endpoints accept valid ECDSA signatures from any role; session-auth endpoint /api/auth/update-pseudo respects Bearer token; duplicate-pseudo register works because pseudo_lower index is partial (verified=True only); /api/accounts/list correctly omits _id and public_key_jwk from response via projection.
